stages.rough: Edit the concept. Keep the palisade of sharpened logs, the plain plank gate and its frame, the plank floor. Remove the guard completely. What he did passes through objects: a spear leans against the gate post, a plain steel helmet sits on top of a log stump, a stool beside it. Rope lashings instead of most iron bands. All logs the same height. The piece runs straight along its long axis and each end stops in a clean vertical cut at full wall height, both ends the same height and the same section, no return, no corner, no ruin, no slope, nothing past the cut, so a wall section can join it. Nobody in the image, no people at all. Footprint unchanged, exactly 1 by 3 tiles, growth goes up and stays inside the canvas. No letters or runes, no hanging cloth, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow, no fog patches, no sheet of grey smoke. Matte, no gloss, no gilding. Feathered natural ground patch, same iso angle, same ink outlines, warm light from the top left.

Two short square towers now flank the arch, rising one storey above the wall, an iron portcullis half raised, timber hoarding on the towers, a blank carved crest over the arch. Torches in iron brackets. A hint of old magic: a faint pale cyan light at the back of the arch. stages.mythic: Edit the concept and go much further. Keep the two thick round stone towers with crenellations and timber hoarding, the great arch, the iron portcullis, the blank carved crest over the arch without any letter or sign, and remove the letter-like marks on the wall. Remove both guards completely and remove the smoke patches. Spears lean in a rack by the gate, helmets rest on the merlons, the pull-up beam and a stack of squared stones stay. The towering element: the two towers are twice as tall as in the concept, far above the wall, each crowned by a tall stone drum, so they stand like two giants at the gate. Strong magic layer, clear by day and by night: a great solid opaque bridge of bright cyan light, a clean band with sharp edges, arcs from one tower top to the other high above the gate, and a curtain of the same light fills the arch behind the portcullis. Windows lit warm, torches on the towers. The wall on each side stays at its plain height, much lower than the towers, and runs only a short way from each tower.
